title: The people weapons never harm
note: By design, some people are protected from any weapon (the smith, a merchant, a story figure). A blow or a shot at one is found (its contact says Protected) but does nothing: no harm, no hurt; the attempt is violence the world sees, and they protest. Each is named by the kind of character it is drawn as: a 1.1 template (Civ03merchant1) or the platform's catalogue name (Merchant). The program's --protected <who> marks more, for a run (on its tape). SANDBOX: the merchants stand in for the smith until the enhanced module's own people are made.
